elysiumlogistics.assembler.dark: Making %s, and no power reaching it.
elysiumlogistics.controller.dark: %s drawers, and no power reaching it.
elysiumlogistics.controller.overloaded: %s drawers on one controller, and it will index %s. Build another.
elysiumlogistics.core.dark: Making %s, and no power reaching it.
elysiumlogistics.core.enormous: That comes to %s machine-runs, which is more than %s assembler(s) will get through in an hour. Ask for fewer, or build more.
elysiumlogistics.core.handless: No assemblers on its bus. It can plan and it cannot build.
elysiumlogistics.core.nothing: Hold up what you want made.
elysiumlogistics.core.nothing_to_make: Nothing here knows how to make %s.
elysiumlogistics.detector.on: %s %s on the network, at least %s: on.
elysiumlogistics.detector.unset: Show it a thing to count. It fires at %s.
elysiumlogistics.device.unfiltered: Moving anything, one stack a second.
elysiumlogistics.drawer.empty: Empty. It will hold %s of each thing.
elysiumlogistics.ender_link.alone: On the %s channel, and nothing else is.
elysiumlogistics.ender_link.unnamed: Show it a thing to name its channel.
elysiumlogistics.exporter.idle: Show it what to send out. Until then it sends nothing, rather than emptying the network.
elysiumlogistics.interface.serving: Serving %s slot(s) to whatever takes from it.
elysiumlogistics.monitor.coreless: No assembly core on its bus, so nothing is being made.
elysiumlogistics.pack.no_room_for_parts: No room for %s: every fitting is taken.
elysiumlogistics.pack.not_a_part: %s is not a part. Hold a part in the other hand to fit it, or nothing to take one out.
elysiumlogistics.pack.nothing_fitted: Nothing is fitted to take out.
elysiumlogistics.pack.too_full: Too full to take that out: %s slot(s) in use would not fit without it.
elysiumlogistics.storage_bus.nothing: Nothing with an inventory in front of it.
elysiumlogistics.terminal.coreless: No assembly core on its bus.
